notes.purpose: v4 tax-audit square ('ביקורת מס'): a bank of multiple-choice questions on Israeli money rules. Same guess-first mechanic as guess.he.json (ask, the player picks, then a reasoned reveal with one fox line) and the same option shape as the tutorial check (tutorial.he.json check.questions). Not loaded by src/data/index.js LEARN_KINDS: existing tests and counts are unchanged.

schema.ui: labels of the square and the reveal. progress has {right} and {of}; badge.progress has {n} and {goal}.
schema.result: fox lines after the answer, like guess.he.json guessResult: correct[], wrong[], skipped[]. One line at random, never the same twice in a row.
schema.reward: knowledge points and a badge ONLY. A question never changes cash, income, expenses, loans or assets. points: per correct answer; badge: earned at badge.goal correct answers in total (not in a row).
schema.questions[]: { id, topic, level ('full'), prompt, options[{ id, text, correct, feedback }], explanation, asOf, source { name, url, kind }, family?, needs_review }. Exactly one option has correct:true. The UI shuffles options. feedback of the correct option never starts with 'נכון' (the UI already shows the title).
schema.family: optional children's variant { prompt, options, explanation } with the same answer logic and simpler numbers. Family variants avoid the adult words of the family vocabulary list (ריבית, תזרים, מקדמה, תשואה, משכנתא, הכנסה פסיבית, התחייבות, כרית...). A question without `family` is full mode only.
schema.topic: vat | income-tax | credit-points | national-insurance | pension | business | labour | interest | prices
schema.source: as in israel.he.json. NOTE: scripts/prune-learn.js drops 'source' keys from the build.

notes.rules: Only VERIFIED figures from docs/v3/real-world-verified.json (2026). Not used: child credit points, credit-card interest, an official 3-6 month emergency fund, the 2026 recuperation daily rate, VAT on a second-hand apartment, teacher pension rates. The Bank of Israel rate (3.25%) is not written in any question because tests/round7.test.js forbids the string in the build (see guide.he.json lesson-interest).
notes.counts: 16 questions, 8 with a family variant (tq-vat-rate, tq-vat-extract, tq-raise-myth, tq-pension, tq-osek-turnover, tq-annual-leave, tq-loan-vs-boi, tq-inflation).
notes.ref: { name, url }: the source link SHOWN next to the 'נכון ל-2026' tag (developer, v4 stage 4). A copy of source.name/url, because scripts/prune-learn.js drops `source` from the build; `ref` survives the prune.
